Eli (Capacity): Quick update: H400 dedicated pools will enter staged availability next week in FRA-1 and LAX-1. This thread covers availability windows, a small reservation policy change, and a short incident we observed in the pilot.
DeployBot: Scheduled window: 2026-07-12 02:00-05:00 UTC for kernel preload and telemetry hooks. Allocation policy: staged-fairshare, decay=0.85.
Eli (Capacity): Key points: H400 is tuned for low-latency chat and mid-length contexts. Median throughput ~1.45x vs h200 for our internal gpt-small family. Micro-reservation support: 1 GPU min, 64 GPU max per reservation for the trial.
Sana (Product): Policy change?
Eli (Capacity): Small policy update during trial: cancellation window reduced to 4 hours prior to start for reserved blocks to allow rapid rebalancing. Well tag trial reservations with `h400-trial` automatically; this enables telemetry and temporary quota increases. No SLA change during trial.
CS Ops: Will this affect customer billing or refunds?
Eli (Capacity): Billing: refunds/pro-rated adjustments handled as normal. The shorter cancellation window only affects capacity reclaims, not billing. CS Ops well add a note to the support template.
Eng Runtime: Runtime hints: enable `kv-cache=true`, set `--quant=fp16` for most models, and `max_batch_size=28` for chat workloads. Watch for warmup noise in the first 20 minutes.
Infra Oncall: Incident summary from pilot: during early kernel preload in FRA-1 we saw transient PCIe link flaps on 3 hosts causing short nvlink error storms and a handful of job retries. Root cause: a vendor driver regression triggered by mixed PCIe AHCI updates.
Infra Oncall: Mitigation: rolled firmware patch and kernel flag `pci_blacklist=0x1a2b` on affected hosts, and we removed those hosts from live allocation for 40 minutes. Post-fix: error rate returned to baseline. No customer-facing errors recorded.
Sana (Product): Any required action for customers?
Infra Oncall: If you have routing policies that assume zero-retry on allocation errors, update to allow 2 retries or provide an explicit fallback pool. We recommend `fallback: stable-dedicated` for safety.
Eli (Capacity): Availability windows (UTC):
 - FRA-1: Mon/Wed/Fri 01:00-05:00 (staged wave A)
 - LAX-1: Tue/Thu/Sat 14:00-18:00 (staged wave B)
 - Burst floor: 6 GPUs per zone outside windows.
DeployBot: Note: preemptible fallbacks are enabled by default for H400 but can be disabled per-reservation with `--preemptible=false`.
CS Ops: Please prepare a short blurb for customers.
Sana (Product): Blurb draft: "H400 dedicated pools (trial): optimized for low-latency chat workloads. Limited regional waves and trial pricing apply. Shorter cancellation window enables faster rebalancing during the trial. Contact Support to request early access"
Eli (Capacity): Example reservation CLI for teams: ```
redwoodctl reservations create --pool h400-fra-1 --gpus 8 --term 168h --tags "h400-trial,lowlatency" --preemptible=true
```
Eng Runtime: Action: we will validate top 12 customer models on H400 kernels by EOD Thu. If you need test reservations, DM me.
Eli (Capacity): Action items: @CS Ops  update support template; @eng-runtime  post perf artifacts; @infra-oncall  monitor nvlink-nerrs for first 48 hours of waves. React with :white_check_mark: when youve picked owners. Keeping this thread for live updates during the staged availability.
